name: Needle driver of the original scene (dVRK Classic-style meshes)
capabilities_basis: The instrument all three PSMs carried before config/instruments existed; it is the instrument of scenes/davinci_endoscope_task.ttt and scenes/davinci_foot_docking_rcm.ttt. Treated like the Large Needle Driver: grasp yes, tissue retraction and cutting no.
reference_basis: Captured from scenes/davinci_endoscope_task.ttt (PSM2) by scripts/build/install_instruments.py, in the dVRK wrist frames. Its jaws differ from the dVRK Si 420006 meshes by about 0.45 mm mean surface distance.

kinematics.jaw_limits_basis: Original scene: each of the two jaw joints spans +-60 deg.
